name: Autoencoder
description: Self-supervised intelligence that learns compressed representations by encoding inputs to a latent bottleneck and reconstructing them. Discovers essential structure by discarding noise. Analogous to how memory compresses experience into meaningful patterns — the art of knowing what to keep.
training_paradigm: minimize reconstruction error through information bottleneck

scope.definition: Compression ratio achievable by trained autoencoder (ratio of input dimension to latent dimension) while maintaining <10% reconstruction MSE on held-out test data, normalized to principal component analysis baseline.

evidence.source: Hinton & Salakhutdinov (2006) 'Reducing the dimensionality of data with neural networks', Science 313:504-507; Bank et al. (2023) 'Autoencoders', arXiv 2003.05991.
cross_domain_examples: deep autoencoder achieves 30:1 compression on MNIST with 0.87 reconstruction fidelity vs 0.65 for PCA
variational autoencoder: disentangled latent dimensions allow interpolation — compression + generation
JPEG image compression: DCT-based 20:1 compression achieving 0.88 SSIM — engineered analogue baseline

scope.falsifiability: If autoencoder reconstruction quality (SSIM or MSE) is statistically indistinguishable from linear PCA at equal compression ratios, deep nonlinear encoding provides no advantage.
scope.measurement_limits: Compression quality is dataset-specific — natural images compress better than random data. Reconstruction fidelity measured on in-distribution data; out-of-distribution samples show degraded reconstruction.

scope.definition: Diversity-fidelity tradeoff of VAE generative samples — FID (Fréchet Inception Distance) score of generated samples relative to training distribution, averaged across standard benchmark datasets.

evidence.source: Kingma & Welling (2013) 'Auto-encoding variational Bayes', ICLR 2014; Razavi et al. (2019) 'Generating diverse high-fidelity images with VQ-VAE-2', NeurIPS.
cross_domain_examples: VAE on CelebA faces: FID 25-40 vs GAN FID 5-15 — VAE diversity is higher, fidelity is lower
VAE latent interpolation produces semantically smooth transitions — continuous structure vs GAN mode collapse
diffusion models: FID 2-8 on ImageNet — state-of-art baseline VAE must overcome

scope.falsifiability: If VAE samples are judged by human raters as indistinguishable from real data at >90% accuracy, the FID-based quality gap between VAE and GAN closes.
scope.measurement_limits: FID is sensitive to architecture and training duration. VAE and GAN occupy different quality-diversity tradeoff points; comparing FID alone misses the diversity advantage of VAEs.
